name: Linkar — used-car mechanical warranty, France
description: Mechanical breakdown warranty for used vehicles, covering repair costs up to €15,000 per year (founder description). Target persona: owners of used vehicles. B2C, one person, bootstrapped, founded Apr 2022, FR. TrustMRR lists ~5,000 estimated users (founder-stated). Listed for sale at $200,000 (1.1x; first listed Dec 19, 2025; 12 offers).
imageAlt: Linkar — used-car mechanical warranty, France product image

mentions.evidence: ~$15,797 MRR (+3.0% L30), 415 active subscriptions, ~$14,502 L30, ~$106,531 last 12 months, ~$299,201 all-time, ~40% L30 profit margin, ~3,713 visitors and ~$3.82 revenue per visitor in L30. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~04:41 Warsaw (02:41 UTC). Note: a second TrustMRR stealth profile with the same Linkar description (CH, founded Nov 2025, ~$15.5k MRR / 38 subs / ~$187k all-time) has an expired Stripe key since Oct 2, so treat that one as stale.
mentions.indieAngle: The real business is the claims ops and an underwriting partner, not the website. In PL, "gwarancja mechaniczna" for 8–15-year-old cars bought from Otomoto is a gap: partner with an insurer or a garage network, sell monthly online, and use the car's VIN/history check as the funnel.

whyItPrints: Monthly insurance-like subscription on a car people already depend on. Customers hate surprise gearbox bills, and once they're covered they rarely cancel while the car is old. 415 subs at ~$38/mo average (my calculation from MRR ÷ subs).
